items.title: SEO / indexing strategy -> docs/SEO_PLAN.md
items.note: docs/SEO_PLAN.md delivered. LIVE AUDIT (VERIFIED 2026-08-17): apex and www both return 200 with IDENTICAL Etag 13x53aqr78w4r74 and byte-identical length, zero redirects between hosts; cross-host rel=canonical is CORRECT on both hosts including deep pages; robots.txt and the 13-URL sitemap are apex-consistent; SSR is GREEN (tested by stripping every script tag - real rendered HTML, not RSC-flight-only, and Googlebot UA returns byte-identical markup). POSITIONING CONFIRMED DRIFTED (DISC-7): the stem 'manage' appears ZERO times across the entire indexed metadata surface of all three audited pages, and one byte-identical MedicalBusiness JSON-LD block asserts 'Nexo Access is a technology-first NEMT company built for the DMV' on all 13 routes. DIAGNOSIS, adversarially reviewed: the www hypothesis was REFUTED as the cause (the 'Alternate page with proper canonical tag' rows are the documented signature of canonicalization SUCCEEDING, and crawl budget does not apply at 13 URLs); the authority hypothesis was rated OVERSTATED because site age and backlinks are unmeasured. Honest verdict: CAUSE UNRESOLVED, collapsible by one owner URL Inspection reading (item P1-C1). The 301 is still specified, but for durability (canonical is a hint, not a rule), NOT as a rescue. Specs delivered: www->apex 301 (three options costed, next.config.mjs redirects() with statusCode 301 recommended, plus proposed harness invariant I19), metadata/JSON-LD rewrite to D1/D15 with the exact blast radius mapped (HERO_LEDE is a COPY GATE event - it is both JSON-LD description and visible hero copy), provider-resource-center organic architecture, and an E-E-A-T posture built entirely from honest signals.

items.title: P1a craft lane: exemplar dissection (Stripe primary, Linear secondary) -> docs/DESIGN_RESEARCH.md part 2
items.note: Stripe full anatomy (13 sections, nav, footer, /enterprise deep page, type), Linear motion only. PRIORITY QUESTION ANSWERED: the stripe.com hero is NOT WebGL today; it is an art-directed <picture> whose assets Stripe itself names wave-fallback-{desktop,tablet,mobile}.png. The live capability gate was captured with a getContext interceptor: WebGL is requested with failIfMajorPerformanceCaveat:true and DECLINED on a software rasterizer, then experimental-webgl, then a granted 2d context. A control canvas in the same document proves the flag is the discriminator (plain webgl true, with-flag false). Standing rule recorded for any future canvas/WebGL work. Performance bar proposed (<=600KB transfer, <=150KB JS, <=1200ms DCL, <=60 requests, Lighthouse >=98) for P2 ratification. Four nexo-motion candidates: nexo-drift, nexo-shape, nexo-settle, nexo-accent-card. Two exemplar defects recorded as what-not-to-copy: Stripe /enterprise ships 20 h1 elements; Linear ships no first-party prefers-reduced-motion CSS (1 of 1359 rules, and it belongs to the sonner toast library) with 103 animations still running under reduced motion. ElevenLabs motion-safe: inversion flagged as the strongest adoption candidate in the sample.

items.title: Motion system: the nexo-motion skill from the four approved candidates + motion-safe architecture
items.note: D20d approved nexo-drift (per-cell AmbientMap dot cycle, 2400-3200ms, static grid under reduced motion), nexo-shape (nav panel size interpolation, 200/250ms, instant swap under reduced motion), nexo-settle (existing play-once settle grammar formalised as a primitive, <=300ms), nexo-accent-card (local dark card on a light section, static - closes a real gap in the tonal system). Governing rules: will-change for imminent transitions only; ambient motion is slow; transform and opacity only; every candidate ships its static end-state first. nexo-shape recommended first.

decisions.title: Cross-project checkpoints
decisions.summary: Between site and platform, relayed by Oli, every exchange documented.

decisions.title: Skills audited, not assumed
decisions.summary: Registry doc; broken tools stopped and fixed, never silently worked around. Extended 2026-08-17 by the REPAIR-FIRST LAW: a skill with missing files gets a repair attempt before any BROKEN verdict.

decisions.title: REVERSAL — git moves to Claude Code
decisions.summary: Build prompts include the git steps; Claude Code stages, commits (one per task), and pushes.

reversal.was: Oli runs all git himself; git never inside a Claude Code prompt.
reversal.now: Claude Code stages, commits with a descriptive message, and pushes to v2.
reversal.why: Manual git caused costly mistakes; removing the human step removes the mistake class. Guardrails: never force-push, never push with tsc red, never touch main except at declared merge gates.

decisions.title: Branch strategy
decisions.summary: All V2 work on v2. CI typechecks and builds every push; the deploy job fires only on main (verified in .github/workflows/ci.yml), so pushing v2 never deploys. Merge v2 -> main only when the 7 quality gates pass.

decisions.title: Identity: text wordmark
decisions.summary: No logo for now. A logo waits until one actually satisfies the owner.

decisions.title: Research-first sequencing
decisions.summary: No page is designed before the research phase documents the industry standard (P1).

decisions.title: Mobbin + Figma design-reference pipeline

decisions.title: Challenge-to-test law (automatic)
decisions.summary: Any task that fixes something genuinely hard must add an automated test covering that problem's whole class, in the same task, same commit. Manual verification recipes are test specs: captured as automation, never performed once and discarded.

decisions.title: SITE_BOARD — the visual HQ
decisions.summary: docs/SITE_PROGRESS.json (committed) is the living status truth; scripts/board.mjs renders self-contained docs/SITE_BOARD.html (gitignored, local render). Regenerated at the end of every task.

decisions.title: V2 visual target: Mobbin-class animated premium
decisions.summary: Performance comes from technique plus measurement, not restraint. P1a gains a technique-teardown workstream (animation library, what is animated, loading strategy, degradation strategy). Research findings no installed skill covers get encoded into new project skills via skill-creator (first candidate: nexo-motion). The static-complete SSR doctrine is retained.

decisions.title: Positioning language refinement (amends D1 expression, not substance)
decisions.summary: Public framing never negates: no “we do not drive”, no “nothing to do with transportation”. We deliver transportation through a credentialed provider network and take responsibility for every trip; providers operate the vehicles, Nexo Access manages and answers for the service. SITE_GROUND_TRUTH section 1 carries the canonical wording.

decisions.title: Handoff-in-parallel protocol (extends D4)
decisions.summary: docs/PLATFORM_DESIGN_HANDOFF.md is maintained WHILE building, never retrospectively: every design decision receives a transfer verdict at decision time (TRANSFERS / ADAPTS / SITE-ONLY) with reason and date. Two different products, one identity. Cross-project checkpoints (D5) continue.

decisions.title: Publish boundary for the resource center: requirements, never advice
decisions.summary: Resource pages state requirements with citations and verification dates. NEVER business-formation, ownership, legal, or financial guidance ("form an LLC" and its relatives are banned). Every resource page carries an informational-only disclaimer and its verification date. Nothing UNRESOLVED or merely REPORTED/OWNER-REPORTED is publishable.

decisions.title: Broad legibility, local operations (refines D2, does not reverse it)
decisions.summary: MCO evaluators contract nationally; the site must read as a national-grade medical transportation management organization whose current operating footprint is the DMV, never as a local-only shop. SEO targets category queries alongside geo queries. Provider resource pages remain state-specific (providers are local); payer-facing surfaces speak nationally. Owner insight on record: the evaluator searching from New York or California must not scroll past us.

decisions.title: Imagery strategy (closes T3)
decisions.summary: Primary imagery = animation + custom illustration in our own visual language. Stock people-photography permanently banned (fake patients read as fake trust). Real photography deferred until real operations exist, then added as truth. The hero receives a new signature animated centerpiece; the current hero is on record as hard to grasp (owner + user feedback). Concept proposed by Claude in P3 as rendered comparisons; owner reacts before build. SafeRide-style flow explanations are built as animation, not video, within this ruling.

decisions.title: P2 technical ratification
decisions.summary: (a) Performance bar adopted as ceiling: <=600KB transfer, <=150KB JS, <=1200ms DCL, <=60 requests on the default profile; P5 measurement may tighten, never loosen. (b) Stripe's decline-don't-degrade rule is standing law for any canvas/GPU work (failIfMajorPerformanceCaveat: true; never render slowly). (c) motion-safe: architecture adopted for V2: motion is switched ON by capability classes, never patched off. (d) The four nexo-motion candidates (nexo-drift, nexo-shape, nexo-settle, nexo-accent-card) approved for P3 exploration and encoding into the nexo-motion skill.
